text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! Please make me your apprentice!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Where did that come from all of a sudden? If you want training, go find someone else.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it. It's not about running, I want to learn how Brian-senpai carries herself!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ridiculous...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That's the stuff!
That's exactly what I want to learn!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, like I've got time for this... do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, from that day on,
Vodka began following Narita Brian around.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I see, so you don't eat vegetables...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then from now on,
I'm not eating my vegetables either!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... So she basically doesn't talk
to anyone during breaks either...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright, guess I'll do that too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I guess I really should chomp on a twig
like Senior does...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Guess I'll go look around for a nice branch nearby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... Listen up, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Do you want to become me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Yes. I want to become
cool like you, Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Does being cool mean imitating me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Even if you imitate me, that won't make it your own coolness."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Understood...!
Thank you so much, Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And seriously, stop holding random sticks in your mouth.
You're gonna get sick...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh, but what about your branch, Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's homemade.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Homegrown...! That's seriously so cool of you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, seriously... give me a break!
